claims.statement: Check the five concise source mappings against exact original PDFs at cited locators. Separate L01 modern model/general theory attribution from sparse-family completeness; L04 quotient rank criterion from deficiency/isotropy and unverified Legendre examples; L05 full-domain symmetry hypotheses; L06 weighted singular Friedrichs model from the constant-coefficient Krein model. Verify stated L04/L06 version cautions and the comparative note directly on originals, including the proposed smooth matching repair and its limited scope. Verify journal-versus-arXiv reading distinctions; no full-paper audit or unproved journal-v1 identity may be claimed.

Verify proof01 in both directions: sqrt2 normalization, even/odd restrictions and extension at zero in H2, actual endpoint and central conditions, reflection reduction of the self-adjoint operator and functional-calculus/domain transport. Check affine low modes and that this alone proves no sparse-family density.

Verify proof02 fully: full-interval Neumann and shifted-Robin positivity, normal strongly elliptic boundary hypotheses against Grubb exact Def2.1/Thm2.2/Cor2.3, reducing parity and shift norm equivalence, both inclusions at all noncritical and critical orders, triangular conversion of powers, weighted zero-extension/Hardy step and norm equivalence. Audit each ordinary/critical trace threshold, x2/p4/q6/affine checks, and c/s dependence. Do not treat the half-interval mixed boundary problem as covered without the supplied bridge.

Verify proof03 fully and independently: elementary positive closed-form representation gives genuine Hc3=ordinaryH3 with Bf=0 and equivalent norms; complex three-centre-trace map onto C3; exact algebraic tail divisibility and endpoint correction; all order-three local cutoff estimates, including the shrinking L2 norm and no improper exchange of delta/degree limits; polynomial approximation and sufficiency. Check cofinite closure is exactly prescribed by retained0,1,4, codimension, p5 and q6 examples, and distinguish an arbitrary selected index set from membership induced by a closed space. No general infinite-delete or critical s=5/2 conclusion follows.

Check proof04 and four proposed cards: genuine regular maximal/minimal domains, deficiency/boundary quotient dimensions, isotropy or correct boundary form, finite residual right inverses, and why a residual-rank check is not a density theorem. Ensure cards preserve all c>0, topology, full versus deleted-family, critical and noncritical limitations, and cite correct own proof/source versions.

Inspect and independently execute or recompute meaningful parts of supplied new exact_checks.py and its 98-assertion/four-counterfactual record. Source project is immutable; run an unmodified script copy in a temporary directory only if it would otherwise write to the frozen source. Numerical or finite rational checks do not certify Sobolev, interpolation, functional calculus or all-degree claims. Report actual execution scope and any unavailable checks.
